notes: Complete individual Bac de Roda Bridge: full mapped road/approaches, staggered pairs of upright and inclined white steel ribs, vertical and diagonal hanger rods, open paired-rib braces, I-section ribs and shoes, bowed outer walks, four broad stair descents/landings, open handrails, deck slab/crossgirders, shaped open underdeck supports and simple road markings. Current tunnels and lower road remain native; no old visible railway is invented. Fixed19m model datum, photo-guided central roadway near27m with ten-metre upright arch rise and longer inclined outer ribs descending to standard-field stair feet. Long end approaches descend toward23.4/22m. Literal support/stair samples fit the unmodified standard viewer field; these are approximate visualization controls, not surveyed structural elevations.
